metaShifts.theme: The Continued Decline of Raw Tankiness
metaShifts.description: This patch amplifies the previous trend of de-emphasizing raw tankiness. Heroes like Axe, Pudge, Centaur Warrunner, Wraith King, and Chaos Knight all received direct nerfs to their inherent durability or scaling strength. The Bloodthorn nerf, which removes damage if the silence is dispelled, also indirectly reduces burst against dispellable tanky targets. This reinforces a meta where sustained brawling is less effective, and compositions focused on burst damage or quick disables will continue to thrive.

metaShifts.theme: A Rebalancing of Early-Mid Game Aggression & Spell Spam
metaShifts.description: Following a patch that saw the rise of mobile and spell-spamming aggressors, 7.36c attempts to rein in this dominance. Numerous heroes known for strong early-mid game pressure and frequent spell usage, such as Shadow Fiend, Vengeful Spirit, Storm Spirit, Clockwerk, Leshrac, Dark Seer, Night Stalker, Bounty Hunter, Weaver, Pangolier, Hoodwink, and Dark Willow, received significant nerfs. The cost increases to Phylactery and Khanda further dampen the early-mid game burst potential. This shift suggests a move away from overwhelming early aggression towards a more measured approach, potentially extending the mid-game phase.

metaShifts.theme: The Rise of Direct Damage & Summon-Based Pressure
metaShifts.description: While spell spam is toned down, this patch subtly buffs heroes who rely on direct damage output or summon-based pressure. Phantom Assassin and Spectre receive buffs to their damage and scaling, while Nature's Prophet's Treants are stronger, and Invoker's Mastermind is improved for denying with controlled units. This suggests a meta where consistent, focused damage or map pressure through summons might be more rewarded than broad area-of-effect spell burst.

The nerf to Arcane Boots' mana regeneration directly impacts the early game sustainability of many supports. This makes mana management a more critical aspect for position 4 and 5 players, potentially favoring heroes with lower mana costs or those who can generate mana through other means. Supports will need to be more judicious with their spell usage or invest in alternative mana solutions.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Receives buffs to base damage and starting evasion, improving her laning and early survivability. The buff to Silver Edge's break duration is also highly synergistic, as it's a core item for her to disable key passives and burst targets.

Desolate's bonus damage is increased at all levels, along with its corresponding talent. This significantly improves her early-mid game damage output, accelerating her farm and making her more impactful in skirmishes, allowing her to come online faster.

Treant damage is increased across all levels of Nature's Call. This directly buffs his farming speed, pushing power, and ability to apply global pressure, making him a more potent split-pusher and map controller.

Mastermind now triggers if units under Invoker's control land a deny. This is a significant quality-of-life and mana sustain buff, especially for Exort Invoker builds utilizing Forge Spirits, allowing for more consistent spell spam and farming efficiency.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The direct nerf to Urn of Shadows and Spirit Vessel, preventing charges from being added when duplicated, severely impacts these heroes' unique item interactions and early-mid game power spikes, making them less effective at snowballing.

Phylactery's cost increase directly impacts Khanda's cost, making these early-mid game burst items less accessible. Bloodthorn's mechanic change, where Soul Rend no longer deals damage if the silence is dispelled, significantly reduces its reliability as a kill item against heroes with dispels, impacting many burst spellcasters.

The decrease in Radiance's burn radius directly impacts the farming speed and teamfight aura presence of heroes who rely on this item, making them slightly slower to scale and less impactful in large engagements.

The mana regeneration decrease on Arcane Boots is a systemic nerf to the early game sustainability of many supports who rely on this item for consistent spell casting and mana distribution to their cores.

Carry.explanation: Buffs to her base damage and starting evasion make her a stronger laning carry, allowing her to trade more effectively and survive harassment. The Silver Edge buff, a core item for her, further enhances her ability to initiate and shut down key passive abilities.

Desolate damage buffs at all levels and its corresponding talent significantly increase her early-mid game damage output. This accelerates her farming speed and makes her more potent in skirmishes, allowing her to reach her critical mass faster and exert map pressure.

The Storm Surge damage buff makes him an even more dominant laning carry. He can harass opponents more effectively, secure last hits with greater ease, and translate this lane advantage into stronger mid-game presence and objective taking.

Mid.explanation: The Mastermind buff, allowing denies with controlled units to trigger mana gain, provides better mana sustain and farming efficiency, particularly for Exort builds utilizing Forge Spirits. This enables more consistent spell spam and faster item timings.

As a strong mid-lane option, Razor benefits from the Storm Surge damage buff, making him an oppressive laner against many matchups. His ability to dominate the mid-lane translates directly into map control and early pressure.

Offlane.explanation: The Sand Storm DPS buff significantly improves his farming speed, push potential, and damage output in teamfights. This makes him a more threatening initiator and area controller, capable of clearing waves and contributing more damage in engagements.

Increased Treant damage enhances his ability to push lanes, farm the jungle, and apply global pressure. As an offlaner, he can create significant space for his team, force rotations, and secure objectives more effectively.

SoftSupport.explanation: No specific Soft Support heroes received direct buffs that significantly elevate their standing. The general meta shift might indirectly benefit some, but no clear winners emerge from the patch notes for this role.

HardSupport.explanation: No specific Hard Support heroes received direct buffs. The nerf to Arcane Boots' mana regeneration is a general hit to the role's early game sustainability, making mana management more challenging for all hard supports.

Carry.explanation: Significant nerfs to Geminate Attack damage and Shukuchi mana cost severely hamper his early game farming, harassment, and burst potential. This makes his laning phase much weaker and slows down his critical item timings.

Corpse Eater nerfs reduce his general tankiness gained from farming creeps, making him less durable unless he's actively securing hero kills. This makes his scaling less consistent and his early-mid game more vulnerable.

Early Shadowraze damage nerfs and Necromastery changes (no souls from non-hero/creep units) significantly slow down his early farming and burst potential. This delays his mid-game power spike and makes him less impactful in early skirmishes.

Mid.explanation: Nerfs to Galvanized charges and Static Remnant vision reduce his early game mobility and scouting capabilities. This makes his ganking and farming less efficient and riskier, impacting his ability to snowball from the mid-lane.

Refraction and Psionic Trap nerfs, along with talent adjustments, reduce her early burst and control. This makes her less dominant in the mid-lane and harder to snowball, requiring more precise execution to secure kills.

The Sleight of Fist bonus hero damage nerf slightly reduces his burst potential. While minor, it makes him marginally less effective in skirmishes and pick-offs, potentially requiring more items to achieve the same impact.

Offlane.explanation: Nerfs to One Man Army linger duration and Culling Blade talents reduce his tankiness and kill threat. This makes him less effective at diving enemy carries and controlling the lane, diminishing his overall impact as a frontline initiator.

Flesh Heap strength gain and Meat Shield duration nerfs reduce his inherent tankiness and sustain. This makes him more vulnerable in the offlane and less impactful in early rotations, requiring more careful positioning.

Base health regen and Rawhide max health gain nerfs reduce his lane sustain and overall tankiness. This makes him easier to harass out of lane and less durable in teamfights, continuing the trend of anti-tank nerfs.
Wall of Replica damage and Normal Punch stun nerfs reduce his teamfight impact and ability to control enemy cores. This makes him less effective at creating chaos and setting up kills for his team.

SoftSupport.explanation: Magic Missile stun and damage nerfs, along with a Wave of Terror talent nerf, severely reduce her early game impact in skirmishes and her ability to secure kills. This makes her less potent as a roaming or aggressive support.

Power Cogs cooldown and mana burn nerfs significantly reduce his early game lane dominance and ganking potential. This makes him less effective at controlling the enemy carry and securing early pick-offs.

Track duration and damage amplification nerfs reduce his team's kill potential and vision control. This makes him less impactful as a roaming support who relies on securing kills and providing vision for his team.
Roll Up duration and Shield Crash barrier nerfs reduce his survivability and control. This makes him a less reliable initiator and playmaker, as he becomes more vulnerable during his key abilities.
Bramble Maze duration and Bedlam changes (no longer castable on allies) reduce her control and utility. This makes her less effective at zoning enemies, protecting allies, and setting up kills.

HardSupport.explanation: The mana regeneration decrease on Arcane Boots is a direct nerf to the early game sustainability of many hard supports. This makes it harder for them to spam spells, sustain their core, and maintain map presence without running out of mana.
